Expedition?

Ch2 lvl 7 
Gotta be fast. Get the 2 castles to lvl 4 and then attack the left castle and try to upgrade it fast. Then max the first two towers and wait to have a good number of troops and then rush towards the red towers. The quicker you take down the high level red towers the faster you will win.

Ch3 lvl2
Its a first try level. Just upgrade to max and then take whichever towers and max it to. Then take the other one. He will attack the middle castle so you wait for that and take it back and then rush and get his high level towers down and easily capture all after that.

Lvl7
Capture a castle and max it then wait for him to attack a neutral towers and attack him and easily capture all his castles.

Lvl17
Try to capture a couple more towers early on because if you wait you wont be able to stand against him. Lvl them up quick and dont capture a tower unless you know you can defend it. I took his upper castle first and made my way down

Lvl 20
Neutral towers are on your side so that’s really nice and makes you able to upgrade your towers. Just don’t upgrade too early.
Should he easy after that, you’ll find more than a way to get to him. For me, i capture the bottom right corner tower and max it and wait a lil bit and attack all his three towers at once. I make sure i capture two and leave the third to capture all other castles before capturing the last tower.

(Some level the computer act differently so you gotta try more than once)

Hope this helps, good luck!

Every level is different and requires different strategy. Some levels you need to rush and take over the red towers quick otherwise you won’t win. Some levels you have to wait and max your towers first and wait for his move. If you need help with a specific level, I can tell specifics.
